from pathlib import Path
import json
home=Path.home()
target='DEV-PRED-A2Z-POSTBUILD-GATE-20261005-E044'
def read(p):
    if not p.is_file() or p.is_symlink():
        return {}
    value=json.loads(p.read_text())
    return value if isinstance(value,dict) else {}
state=read(home/'.local/state/prediction-project-executor'/(target+'.json'))
bus=read(home/'.local/state/prediction-command-bus/tasks'/(target+'.json'))
report_path=home/'.local/share/prediction-project-executor/worktrees'/target/'diagnostic-result/postbuild-gate-result.json'
report=read(report_path)
reason='RESULT_NOT_AVAILABLE'
if report:
    if 'EXPERIMENT_TESTS_STARTED_WITHOUT_ASTRA_POSTBUILD_APPROVAL' in report.get('traceback',''):
        reason='POSTBUILD_APPROVAL_MISSING'
    elif report.get('regression_success') is True:
        reason='TARGETED_GATE_PASS_NOT_FULL_E2E'
    else:
        reason='REGRESSION_ERROR'
prior=report.get('prior_evidence',{})
repair=report.get('repair_state',{})
raw=' '.join(str(line) for item in prior.get('repair_events',[]) for line in item.get('errors',[]))
repair_reason='SHARED_COORDINATOR_OUTSIDE_SCOPE' if 'blocked write outside task roots' in raw else 'SEE_REPAIR_EVIDENCE'
out=Path.cwd()/'diagnostic-result'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(out/'e044-readback.json').write_text(json.dumps({'target':target,'executor_state':state,'bus_state':bus,'result':report,'test_repeated':False,'production_modified':False},indent=2))
summary={'found':bool(report),'bus':bus.get('state',bus.get('status','UNKNOWN')),'executor':state.get('status','MISSING'),'tests':report.get('tests_run'),'cause':reason,'repair':repair.get('status','UNKNOWN'),'repair_reason':repair_reason}
print('E044_RESULT '+json.dumps(summary,separators=(',',':')),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if report.get('regression_success') is True else 1)
